title: Richer Evia college demo
details: Maths Level 2 and English Level 2 are now available in the demo alongside one Mock Practical
The demo course now has two clear evidence paths and three evidence opportunities including an audio reflection
QR sharing, receiving and provider course-management areas now explain what they do instead of appearing broken in the demo
The DEMO indicator is now a small yellow circle below Targets rather than a bar covering Evia
summary: Evia v216 makes the college demo easier to understand while keeping the full QR-activated learner version unchanged.
changes: Exposed Maths and English in Demo mode
Expanded the demo course to two navigation paths with photo and audio evidence
Added demo explanations for full-version QR exchange and licensed course-pack features
Moved the demo badge away from Evia into a compact yellow circle below Targets
Created a fresh v216 offline cache
